words.prose: {{ar:قَدَّرَ}} ({{tr:qaddara}}) is active and perfect, so measured apportionment is presented as a completed act of the same carried subject, not as a passive state of being restricted. Its Form II shape and doubled middle consonant make the action feel like exact calibration: limits, capacities, and proportions are assigned rather than vaguely estimated. The missing object is crucial. The ayah does not name what was measured, so the measured field opens back toward the created order while remaining compressed enough to be picked up again by {{ar:هَدَىٰ}} ({{tr:hadā}}). The root range keeps measure from sounding like bare constraint: amount, decree, capacity, worth, and fitted proportion converge into enabled fitness. The concrete vessel-like image makes capacity feel like a bounded holding-space for function, and the variant pressure toward ability keeps the limit ordered toward capability; local grammar still keeps measured apportionment as the selected role. In sequence, {{ar:قَدَّرَ}} ({{tr:qaddara}}) is the pivot after the forming of {{ar:سَوَّىٰ}} ({{tr:sawwā}}) and before guidance, so creation is not merely complete but calibrated for a directed course. The marked q-d-r and h-d-y pairing makes the measure-to-guidance relation deliberate rather than incidental. The fuller creation-measure formula in 25:2 sharpens the contrast: there the object is overt, while here the objectless verb makes the scope broader and more compact.

words.prose: {{ar:هَدَىٰ}} ({{tr:hadā}}) lands as the ayah's closing result. It is a perfect active verb, matching {{ar:قَدَّرَ}} ({{tr:qaddara}}) in completed verbal shape while changing the endpoint from calibrated measure to directed course. The active Form I keeps the same subject as the one who supplies direction; it is not a passive recipient-centered form, not a reflexive taking-guidance, and not a seeking-guidance form. The object is unspoken, and no path phrase is named, so the guidance remains coextensive with whatever the prior verb measured. That compression makes direction itself the predicate: the measured field is shown, led, and oriented toward its fitting course rather than merely informed. The wider root family adds conveyance pressure, including course and gift-like movement toward a recipient, so what has been measured feels carried toward an end as well as instructed; local grammar keeps direct guidance as the selected role. The marked local pairing with {{ar:قَدَّرَ}} ({{tr:qaddara}}) makes guidance the expected correlate of measure. The echo with {{ar:ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ}} ({{tr:thumma hadā}}) in 20:50 matters as contrast: that passage pairs creation with guidance, while 87:3 tightens the pattern into measure followed by consequential guidance through {{ar:فَهَدَىٰ}} ({{tr:fa-hadā}}). Recitationally the long final ā lets the clause end open after the compressed doubling of {{ar:قَدَّرَ}} ({{tr:qaddara}}), so the ayah closes not on limitation but on directed release.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fa-linked verbs qaddara at word 2 and hada at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measured extent, deliberate proportioning, and intended direction form a causal pair: calibration equips a thing with a fitting trajectory.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent supplies the bounded end toward which the course can run.
Deliberate estimating and arrangement make qaddara an active calibration stage.
Course, manner, and intended direction make hada the trajectory produced by calibration.

changed_reading.before: He decreed and then, as a separate act, guided.
changed_reading.after: He assigned a measured extent and thereby gave each measured thing a course toward its fitting reach.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Qaddara can name both effective capacity and constriction, while hada can name gentle direction within a course.
baseline_models.mechanism: Measure establishes a field of affordances by giving both capacity and limits; guidance makes that bounded field navigable rather than abolishing its constraints.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity supplies what the measured subject is actually able to do.
Constriction to a scant measure supplies the limiting edge of the possibility field.
Gentle indication supplies usable orientation without forcing the traveler.
An intended course turns the limits and capacities into a traversable route.

changed_reading.before: Guidance supplies a destination independently of what has been allotted.
changed_reading.after: The allotment first defines capacity and constraint; guidance then orients action inside that bounded possibility space.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The measured fit of qaddara is followed by hada branches of going ahead and leading someone into an intended relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A fitting placement is prepared, then guidance operates as accompaniment or conveyance: it goes in front and brings the subject into relation with the prepared end.

activation_trace.role: Fitting proportion supplies the prepared placement or correspondence.
The leading front makes guidance embodied precedence rather than detached information.
Being led into a destined relation supplies escorted arrival as the social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: He gave directions to an already situated recipient.
changed_reading.after: He fitted the destination and then went ahead of, accompanied, or conveyed the recipient into its intended relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Qaddara can be deliberate composition, and hada can be the gracious dispatch of a gift or of verse.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is carefully arranged can itself be what is sent: guidance becomes a proportioned communication whose measured form belongs to its delivery.

activation_trace.role: Estimating, intending, and arranging supply the composition of the thing to be conveyed.
A gracious gift sent to one held close supplies the mode of benevolent delivery.
Sending or exchanging verse makes measured verbal form a possible vehicle of guidance.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an immaterial directive following a decree.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately proportioned communication is graciously dispatched, so its crafted form participates in how it guides.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calibration can guide by making form legible: a measured thing bears a distinguishing mark that can be recognized across the boundary between the manifest and the concealed.

activation_trace.role: Fitting proportion supplies a structured form capable of carrying diagnostic features.
Gentle indication anchors the reading of a sign as a mode of guidance.
A visible identifying mark supplies the sign-bearing substrate of the mechanism.
A distinguishing trace that guides toward its object joins recognition directly to orientation.
Ocular manifestation supplies the readable face of the sign.
Removal of concealment supplies the transition by which a latent measure becomes evident.

structural_cues: The name in 87:1 precedes the measured-and-guided pair, while 87:7 explicitly spans what is manifest and what is concealed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an identifying mark, a distinguishing trace that guides, manifestation, and disclosure; I infer that calibrated form may guide by becoming legible. A live alternative is that these branches concern divine naming and knowledge without placing signs inside measured things.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an instruction delivered to a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may also be the readability designed into a measured form, where its marks disclose the course or condition proper to it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent fa-pairs behave as coupled operations: creation moves into integrity, while calibration moves into direction. Hada is thus the dynamic counterpart of making a formed thing straight and complete.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate preparation and proportioning supply the second pair's formative first operation.
Intended direction supplies the second pair's dynamic completion.
Creating as estimating and measuring makes the two verses materially overlap rather than merely list acts.
Straightness and intrinsic completion supply the stable result paired with creation.
Turning and aiming toward a direction bridges formal completion to the course named by hada.

structural_cues: 87:2 and 87:3 are adjacent relative clauses with the same verb-fa-verb architecture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation as measurement, taswiya as completion and directional aiming, and hada as intended course; I infer that the parallel syntax couples form-completion with course-giving. The live alternative is a non-mechanistic list of independent divine acts.

changed_reading.before: Qaddara is a fixed decree followed by moral instruction.
changed_reading.after: After form is brought to integrity, its calibration is completed dynamically by giving that form a direction in which its proportions can operate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The course produced by measure is a schedule of phase transitions: latent emergence, nutritive flourishing, deliberate state-change, exhaustion into debris, and darkening. Guidance can carry a thing through loss of a former form, not only toward increase.

activation_trace.role: Measured extent, limit, and term supply the temporal envelope of the life course.
Course and intended direction anchor the changing states as one trajectory.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the emergence phase.
Pasture and grazing supply the nutritive phase and its ecological function.
Making a thing become a state supplies the directional transition rather than accidental decay.
Pasture becoming brittle debris supplies senescence as a specified phase of the same material.
Blackness or red tending to black supplies the visible terminal condition of that transition.

structural_cues: 87:4 repeats the relative-clause frame of 87:2-3, and 87:5 continues it with fa plus a causative transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, pasture, caused state-change, debris, and darkening; I infer that this ordered material sequence instantiates the measured course of 87:3. A live alternative is that 87:4-5 only exemplifies power and transience, without defining hada.

changed_reading.before: Guidance moves a living thing toward flourishing as a terminal success.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be the entire measured itinerary of a living material, including emergence, nourishment, senescence, and disintegration.

context_deltas.mechanism: For a human recipient, calibrated guidance becomes recurrent and adaptive: recitation gathers and delivers, forgetting threatens loss, reminder reactivates, facilitation lowers resistance, and benefit appears through responsive reception.

activation_trace.role: Effective but finite capacity makes the delivery answer to what the recipient can carry.
Gentle indication supplies the non-coercive guidance repeatedly restored by the loop.
Recitation and causing another to recite supply the repeatable delivery operation.
Loss of remembered content supplies the failure mode against which recurrence works.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply adaptive reduction of friction.
A reminder that makes remembering happen supplies the explicit reactivation signal.
Recovery after forgetting supplies the recipient-side completion of reactivation.
Benefit rather than harm supplies the loop's functional test.
Fear joined with awe supplies one live receptive state that converts reminder into response.

structural_cues: 87:6-8 promises recitation, retention, and facilitation; 87:9-10 then moves to conditional reminding and actual recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, forgetting, ease, reminder, recovered memory, benefit, and awe; I infer a feedback loop calibrated to finite human capacity. A live alternative is that these are separate promises and exhortations rather than a cognitive mechanism of hada.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is a single universal route assigned once.
changed_reading.after: Guidance is also a repeated intervention fitted to memory and resistance, with recitation and reminder restoring a course that can be received or ignored.

context_deltas.mechanism: The measured field contains a guided corridor but not a forced outcome. A recipient can move laterally away from it, enter hardship, and reach an arrested condition lacking both decisive ending and beneficial life.

activation_trace.role: Constriction supplies the bounded corridor within which direction has consequence.
An intended course supplies the route from which departure becomes intelligible.
Moving apart and withdrawing supplies active lateral departure from the offered course.
Difficulty and suffering supply the resistant trajectory opened by that departure.
Loss of force and life supplies one denied terminal state.
Life as benefit and good supplies the other denied terminal state, yielding suspended non-arrival.

structural_cues: 87:10-13 contrasts recollection with active avoidance and then describes a state that is neither death nor life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an intended course, active separation, hardship, loss of life-force, and beneficial life; I infer that refusal is a branch away from a bounded route and that its result is arrested motion. A live alternative is a punishment sequence unrelated to the mechanics of qaddara fa-hada.

changed_reading.before: Once a course is measured, its realization is deterministic.
changed_reading.after: Measure can bound a real course without coercing uptake: guidance makes orientation available, while an agent may step aside into a non-arriving trajectory.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance can resemble a furrow rather than a signpost: calibrated division makes a fitted channel, and growth or purification develops by proceeding within that worked form.

activation_trace.role: Fitting proportion supplies the dimensions of a channel suited to what will grow in it.
Course and intended direction turn the worked channel into a model of guidance.
The cultivator who cuts open the earth supplies the material operation that forms the channel.
Growth and increase supply the developmental result of proceeding in the cultivated form.
Fitness and suitability bind growth back to the measured fit in qaddara.

structural_cues: 87:14 joins success to self-purification after the earlier pasture sequence has already made growth a live material domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cultivation by cutting earth, growth, and fitness; I infer that a worked furrow can model how measure channels development. A live alternative is that falaha and tazakka carry only success and ethical purification here, with no agrarian mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Guidance points from outside toward a pre-existing route.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be the measured channel worked into a life, within which fitted growth and purification become possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measure assigns not only magnitude but term, and guidance orients choice across temporal horizons. The nearer option competes with a later course whose value is disclosed by beneficial persistence and final outcome.

activation_trace.role: Measure that includes limit and term supplies the temporal calibration of competing ends.
Intended direction supplies orientation through time rather than only through space.
Preference by choice supplies the selection point between rival horizons.
Nearness supplies the immediacy that makes one horizon attractive.
Deferral to a later time supplies the competing delayed horizon.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies a criterion other than immediacy.
Duration and persistence supply the later course's decisive temporal property.
Return to final outcome supplies the endpoint by which a guided choice can be evaluated.

structural_cues: 87:16-17 explicitly contrasts a preferred near life with what is later, better, and more lasting; 87:18 then invokes what came before.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies choice, nearness, delay, benefit, persistence, and final outcome; I infer that hada can orient by the durability of an end while qaddara supplies its term. A live alternative is a moral comparison appended to, rather than generated by, the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Hada directs movement toward a spatial or immediate target.
changed_reading.after: Hada also calibrates temporal vision, directing preference away from the nearest option toward the course whose good survives its full term.

context_deltas.mechanism: The composed-gift baseline acquires a transmission chain: measured content is voiced, kept in circulation by mention and reminder, fixed on written surfaces, and inherited from prior witnesses.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate arrangement supplies the proportioned composition transmitted through different media.
Gracious dispatch of a gift supplies transmission as benevolent delivery.
Offering verse supplies crafted speech as a concrete guidance medium.
Recitation and causing recitation supply oral realization of the composed content.
Mention flowing on the tongue supplies continued oral circulation.
A written page supplies durable inscription as another carrier.
The repeated written-page branch supplies transmission across more than one named witness.
Beginning and precedence supply the inherited earlier layer of the transmission chain.

structural_cues: The context moves from promised recitation in 87:6 through repeated remembrance to the written pages named in 87:18-19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies composition, gracious dispatch, verse, recitation, voiced mention, written pages, and precedence; I infer a media chain in which the arranged form of guidance is preserved through transmission. A live alternative is that the revelation material is a later topic and does not reactivate qaddara fa-hada.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is an immaterial act that reaches its recipient without a carrier.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be deliberately composed content whose measure survives oral repetition, remembrance, inscription, and inheritance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the dominant hada images of supported gait and composure with the packet's non-dominant ه د د mapping for collapse, heavy tread, and difficult descent. It remains anchored in the actual focus occurrence and in qaddara's fitting proportion, but downstream prose should present it as a split-root, embodied analogy rather than as the lexical meaning of hada.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs fitting proportion with hada, whose packet inventory includes supported walking and calm bearing as well as a mapped split inventory of load, collapse, and descent.

activation_trace.role: Fitting proportion supplies bodily calibration adequate to a path and its load.
Supported, swaying walking supplies guidance as assistance for vulnerable movement.
Calm, composed bearing supplies the stable manner maintained during passage.
Collapse and structural breaking supply the failure that calibrated support averts.
Heavy tread supplies the load-bearing demand placed on the fitted course.
A difficult descent supplies the terrain through which assistance must preserve composure.

changed_reading.before: Guidance gives an able traveler information about a route.
changed_reading.after: Guidance may be imagined as calibrated support that carries a vulnerable traveler through load and descent without collapse, preserving a composed gait.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because race-order and hoof-trace images cross domains into the focus. It remains valid as an analogy because hada itself supplies a leading front and the context independently supplies following immediately behind and tracking a predecessor. Downstream prose should call it a processional or relay model, not claim that prayer or preference literally means racing here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Hada at the focus word can designate the leading front, allowing later branches of following a predecessor's trace to reactivate it.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate arrangement supplies ordered placement within the moving sequence.
The leading front supplies the predecessor who opens the route.
The one immediately following the leader supplies ordered succession rather than detached instruction.
Following the predecessor in a race repeats the successor position in a second context occurrence.
Traveling on a predecessor's trace supplies the durable path linking leader and follower.
A hoof deliberately marked so its track can be followed supplies engineered traceability.

changed_reading.before: Guidance transfers route knowledge from a guide to isolated recipients.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be an ordered relay: a leading front advances, successors occupy measured positions, and a deliberately legible trace lets the movement continue.

strongest_changes: The adjacent creation-completion and calibration-course pairs make guidance the dynamic realization of measured form.
The pasture sequence revises guidance from progress toward flourishing into a full itinerary that can include senescence and disintegration.
Recitation, forgetting, facilitation, and reminder make human guidance recurrent and adaptive rather than a one-time assignment.
The near, later, beneficial, and lasting contrast turns guidance into orientation across temporal horizons.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained causal, ecological, cognitive, social, textual, and temporal readings at once. Split mappings were especially productive: the name-root cue yielded visible marking, while the non-dominant focus mapping exposed a carefully contained model of supported passage under load.
remaining_uncertainties: The fa sequence can support causal coupling, but it may mark ordered acts without saying that measure itself produces guidance.
The context mechanisms may instantiate 87:3 or may remain neighboring demonstrations and exhortations.
The split-root and cross-domain branches are packet-authorized activators, but their changed readings should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Measured capacity becoming a path.** Lexical evidence: ق د ر B001/B003/B005 (measure, capacity, deliberative arranging), ه د ي B001/B002 (guidance and course). Structural cue: the fa- sequence after 87:2 makes تقدير the condition for هداية. Assigned role: measure sets limits and capacities; guidance directs within those limits. Abductive move: direction is meaningful only when the recipient has a bounded capacity and route. Reading change: "destined" is not fatalistic closure but calibrated enablement toward a way.

2. **Narrowing that produces ease.** Lexical evidence: ق د ر B004 (narrowing to scant measure), ي س ر B001/B002 in 87:8 (ease and small amount), د ن و B002 in 87:16 (nearer/first side). Structural cue: قدر precedes "We will ease you toward ease." Assigned role: constriction or exact measure becomes the channel that makes the later path easy. Abductive move: a narrowed channel can reduce wandering and therefore enable movement. Reading change: guidance may include limitation, not merely expansion.

3. **Leading-front imagery.** Lexical evidence: ه د ي B003 (leading front part), خ ر ج B001/B002 in 87:4 (bringing out), ر ع ي B001/B002 (pasture/shepherding). Structural cue: after measured guidance, pasture is brought out, then reminder guides fearful hearers. Assigned role: هدى becomes a lead position that draws beings forward from hiddenness or inertia. Abductive move: the packet's emergence and reminder scenes share a guide-ahead mechanism. Reading change: guidance reads as being led out into a visible course.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:8 surprised this ayah: تيسير made تقدير look like facilitative constraint. 87:4 also made هدى more spatial; guidance is not only instruction but a leading-out motion that organizes emergence.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Measure becomes guidance.** Lexical evidence: قدر B001 measured extent/limit and B005 arranging by deliberation; هدي B001 gentle guidance toward way/truth. Structural cue: the فـ sequence makes guidance follow measuring. Assigned role: قدر sets capacities and limits; هدي shows the way that fits them. Abductive move: the packet supplies measure and guidance; I infer that guidance is calibrated rather than generic. Reading change: guidance reads as proportioned to created capacity.

2. **Constriction as part of direction.** Lexical evidence: قدر B004 narrowing to a scant measure; يسر B001 ease in 87:8; دنو B002 nearer/lower life in 87:16. Structural cue: measure sits before later easing and before the critique of preferring the nearer life. Assigned role: limits define the path and prevent false expansion. Abductive move: the packet gives constriction and ease; I infer that divine making-easy does not erase boundaries but makes the right bounded course passable. Reading change: "measured, then guided" includes restriction as mercy, not only abundance.

3. **Guidance as leading front and offering.** Lexical evidence: هدي B003 leading front part; هدي B005 offering sent to sanctuary; سبح B008 sacred precinct place-name; صلو B003 worship in 87:15. Structural cue: the surah moves from command to path to ritual prayer and older scriptures. Assigned role: guidance can be a leading sign and a devotional sending. Abductive move: the packet supplies "leading" and "offering"; I infer a ritualized path because later remembrance/prayer embodies the guidance. Reading change: the ayah can sound like being led ahead toward worship, not simply receiving information.

4. **Measured guidance as archival continuity.** Lexical evidence: قدر B005 calculation; هدي B002 course/manner; صحف B002 written sheet and ءول B001 firstness in 87:18-19. Structural cue: the final ayat locate "this" in earlier sheets. Assigned role: guidance is a repeatable course preserved across records. Abductive move: the packet gives course plus written transmission; I infer that the measured way is stable enough to be inscribed and inherited. Reading change: the ayah's guidance becomes historically continuous.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:8 retrospectively changed "فهدى": if the addressee is made easy for ease, guidance is not only direction but facilitation. 87:18-19 made the course older than the immediate speaker, linking قدر/هدى to the "first sheets."

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Measure becomes a routed course.** `ق د ر/B005` is arrangement by estimate and deliberation, while `ه د ي/B002` is the course, manner, and intended direction of a matter. The parallel with `خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ` in 87:2 and the concrete growth sequence in 87:4–5 provide the structural cue. Measure sets capacities and relations; guidance routes them through an ordered development. I infer that proportion enables direction, which is the unstated causal force of `فـ`. The ayah reads as calibrated routing rather than a decree followed by unrelated instruction.
2. **Determination includes productive limits.** `ق د ر/B004` gives constriction to a scant measure, alongside `ق د ر/B001` for a bounded extent. Pasture’s reduction to chaff in 87:4–5 and the exception to non-forgetting in 87:6–7 activate limitation as part of the surrounding order. The limiting branch assigns edges and termini to what is guided. I infer that depletion and exception exemplify boundedness rather than failures of the plan. The reading changes from unlimited allotment to guidance operating through deliberately finite capacities and phases.
3. **Guidance can be a proportioned gift.** `ه د ي/B004` is a gracious gift sent to someone close. Within the window, 87:6 gives causative recitation and 87:8 gives facilitation toward ease; these form a recipient-oriented sequence after `قَدَّرَ`. The gift branch makes guidance something tailored and delivered, with measure determining its fit. I infer that recitation and ease are instances or means of the gift; the packet does not name them as its contents. The ayah can therefore read as measure followed by a fitted benefaction, not only abstract direction.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:6 and 87:8 made `ه د ي/B004` newly legible as a fitted gift: recitation is delivered and the recipient is facilitated toward ease. Conversely, 87:4–5 and the exception in 87:7 showed that `ق د ر` includes limits and endpoints, correcting any reading of measure as simple abundance.

baseline.text: O ölçüyü belirledi, ardından yol gösterdi.

findings.text: Belirlenen ölçü, her varlığı kapasitesine uygun bir yola sevk eden ayarlı yönlendirmeye dönüşür.
Ölçünün daraltıcı sınırları da yol göstermenin parçasıdır; kolaylaştırma, bu sınırları kaldırmak yerine doğru yolu geçilebilir kılar.
Yol gösterme, 87:6 ve 87:8'de okuma ve kolaylaştırma olarak alıcıya uygun biçimde ulaştırılan bir armağan niteliği kazanır.
Ön sıra ve adak çağrışımları, yol göstermeyi ibadete doğru önden götüren bir sevk olarak düşündürür.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **87:3.** “Ölçtü, sonra yol gösterdi” ayetinde birincil okuma, Allah’ın her varlığa sınırını, kapasitesini ve yolunu verdiğidir. Sürpriz ikincil okuma, ölçünün bazen genişletme değil daraltma olabileceğini gösterir: doğru rehberlik, sınırsız serbestlik değil, yaratılmış kapasiteye uygun bir kolaylaştırmadır. Ayrıca bu rehberlik yalnız anlık bir işaret değil, sûrenin sonunda eski sahifelerde kayıtlı olduğu görülen süreklilik taşıyan bir yoldur. {ق د ر:B001,B004,B005,B006; ه د ي:B001,B002,B003; ي س ر:B001; ص ح ف:B002}

lexicalization_scope.note: Kap adı ile pişmiş ürün, pişirme eylemi, çorba suyu söz öbeği ve görevli adı ayrı facetlerde tutulur; türev anlamlar kap adına yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Et veya yemek pişirmeye yarayan kabı ve bu kaba bağlı söz ailesini kapsar: kapta pişmiş yemek, pişmiş çorba suyu, kapta pişirme eylemi ve hayvanı kesip yemeği pişiren görevli bu ailede ayrı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Et veya yemek pişirmeye yarayan kabı bildirir.
Kapta pişirilmiş et veya yemeği sonuç ürünü olarak bildirir.

Hayvanı kesme ve ardından eti pişirme işini üstlenen kasap veya aşçıyı bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sevgi bağı bulunan birine incelik ve iyilik amacıyla gönderilen armağanı, karşılıklı armağan vermeyi, armağanın sunulduğu tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişiyi açıkça kapsar. Dal çerçevesi bütün bu türevleri doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak armağan ve armağan verme alanı tanımlanır; kutsal amaçlı sunu, gelini eşine götürme ve şiirsel atışma anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik ve iyilik göstergesi olarak bir şey gönderme ya da verme ve verilen şeydir. Karşılıklı armağanlaşma, sunma tabağı ve bunu sık yapan kişi bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Sevgi veya yakınlık duyulan birine incelik göstergesi olarak verilen şeydir.
Böyle bir armağanı birine göndermek veya vermek eylemidir.
İnsanların birbirlerine karşılıklı armağan vermesini kapsar.
Armağanın üzerine konduğu tabağı ve sık armağan veren kişiyi adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar armağanı yakınlık duyulan kişiye incelik ve iyilik amacıyla verilen şey olarak tanımlar; verme eylemi, karşılıklı verme, sunma tabağı ve sık veren kişi bu ortak çekirdeğin bağlı türevleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Armağanın kendisini, verilmesini ve yakınlık kuran karşılıklı değişimi birlikte temsil eden genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Armağanı, incelik amacını, verme eylemini ve karşılıklılığı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakınlık ve incelik göstergesi olarak verilen nesnenin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: İncelik amacıyla verilen şey olma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Verme eylemini, karşılıklılığı, sunma tabağını ve sık veren kişi anlamını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların birbirlerine karşılıklı olarak armağan verdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklı armağan verme ilişkisini ve yakınlık yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek armağanın adını, sunma tabağını ve sık veren kişi anlamını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Seçkin veya ender bulunan bir nesne ve birine iyilikte bulunma vurgusu komşu dalda öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da birine yakınlık ve iyilik göstergesi olarak sunulan armağanı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal armağan verme olayını ve ona bağlı karşılıklılık ile araç ve kişi adlarını geliştirir; komşu dal sunulan seçkin nesne veya iyilik yönünde daha dardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün armağan, bağış ve iyilik adayları değerlendirildi; incelik amaçlı armağana en yakın sınırı veren aday seçildi.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدية والهدايا والإهداء بمعنى العطية اللطيفة إلى ذي مودة والتهادي بين الناس والمهدى الطبق والمهداء كثير الإهداء

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kutsal eve veya bölgeye yakınlaşma amacıyla gönderilen hayvanı, malı ya da eşyayı bildirir; bazı anlatımlar alanı özellikle büyükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlar, bazıları daha geniş tutar. Dal çerçevesi bu kapsam değişkenliğini ve deveye uzanan kullanımı korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak adanmış sunu anlamı tanımlanır; sıradan armağan, ibadete giriş ve kutsal yolculuğun kendisi bu dala katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kutsal eve veya bölgeye yakınlık kazanma amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen hayvan, mal ya da eşyadır. Kimi anlatımlar bunu özellikle büyükbaş hayvanlara bağlar; develerin genel olarak aynı adla anılması ise bu kullanımdan genişlemedir.

facets.statement: Kutsal bir hedefe yakınlık amacıyla ayrılıp gönderilen sunudur.
Sununun kapsamı kimi anlatımlarda büyükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlı, kimilerinde mal ve eşyayı da içerecek kadar geniştir.
Develerin genel olarak bu adla anılması, kutsal yere gönderilen deve sunusundan gelişen bir genişlemedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kutsal hedefe yakınlık amacıyla gönderilen sunuda birleşir; kapsamın yalnızca büyükbaş hayvanlar mı yoksa mal ve eşya da mı olduğu değişir, develerin genel adı olarak kullanım da bu çekirdekten genişler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yakınlık amacıyla kutsal hedefe gönderilen sununun kaynaklardaki dar ve geniş kapsamlarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kutsal hedefi, adama amacını ve hayvandan mal ile eşyaya değişen kapsamı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kutsal bölgeye gönderilen sununun özellikle büyükbaş bir hayvan olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Develere uzanan adlandırma genişlemesini doğrudan korur.
error_profile.loses: Kutsal hedef, adama amacı ve başka tür sunular bu kısa karşılıkta görünmez.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kutsal yakınlık elde etmek amacıyla sunulan veya yapılan şeyi kapsar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدي أو الهدي المشدد والمخفف بمعنى ما يهدى إلى مكة أو الحرم أو بيت الله من النعم أو المال أو المتاع قربة وما توسع منه إلى البدنة والإبل
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهدي والهدي ما أهديت إلى مكة؛ كل شيء تهديه من مال أو متاع فهو هدي (ayn)؛ الهدي ما يهدى إلى الحرم من النعم؛ مالى هدي؛ حتى يبلغ الهدى محله (sihah)؛ أهديت الهدي إلى بيت الله؛ الهدي خفيف وعليه هدية أي بدنة؛ ما يهدى إلى مكة من النعم وغيره من مال أو متاع؛ العرب تسمي الإبل هديا (tahdhib)؛ الهدي مختص بما يهدى إلى البيت؛ فما استيسر من الهدي؛ هديا بالغ الكعبة (mufradat)؛ الهدي والهدي ما أهدي من النعم إلى الحرم قربة إلى الله تعالى (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü gelini eşinin yanına götürme, bir araya getirip katma eylemini, bu eylemin adını ve götürülen gelinin adlandırılmasını birlikte verir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu olay ve katılımcı ayrımını doğru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gelini eşine götürme ve götürülen gelin anlamları tanımlanır; armağan verme ya da düğünün bütün aşamaları bu dala taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir gelini eşinin yanına götürmek, onunla bir araya getirip ona katmak ve bu götürülme olayıdır. Aynı alan, eşine götürülen gelinin kendisini de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Gelini eşinin yanına götürme ve onunla bir araya getirme eylemidir.
Gelinin eşine götürülmesi olayının adı olarak kullanılır.
Eşinin yanına götürülen gelinin kendisini adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelini eşine götürme ve onunla birleştirme eyleminde birleşir; eylem adı ile götürülen gelini belirten edilgen adlandırma aynı olay yapısına bağlanır. Gelin adının eşine götürülmeden veya kocasının yanında tutsak benzeri sayılmasından doğduğu yönünde iki açıklama aktarılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Götürme eylemini, olayın adını ve götürülen gelin katılımcısını aynı çekirdek altında temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Gelini eşine götürme, birleştirme ve götürülen gelin katılımcısını korur.

error_profile.loses: Olay adını ve götürülen gelinin adlandırılmasını tek başına karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemden etkilenen gelinin adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.loses: Götürme eylemini ve olayın adını doğrudan ifade etmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Eşine götürülen gelinin edilgen adla anılması ve birleştirme ilişkisi bu dalda belirgindir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Düğün alayı, gelini taşıma ve gelinin taşındığı kapalı taşıt komşu dalın alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da gelinin eşinin yanına götürülmesi aşamasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal götürme eylemi ile gelin katılımcısını adlandırır; komşu dal aynı olayın tören, taşıma ve taşıt yönlerini daha ayrıntılı kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Eş, evlilik, düğün, gelin taşıma ve evliliksizlik adayları değerlendirildi; aynı olay aşamasını paylaşan en yakın komşu seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه هديت المرأة أو العروس إلى زوجها وهداؤها وكونها مهدية أو هدي في معنى مفعول
branches.source_phrase_ar: الهداء مصدر قولك هديت المرأة إلى زوجها؛ وهي مهدية وهدي (sihah)؛ هديت العروس فأنا أهديها هداء؛ أهدى الرجل امرأته جمعها إليه وضمها؛ المرأة سميت هديا لأنها كالأسيرة عند زوجها أو لأنها تهدى إلى زوجها (tahdhib)؛ الهدي يقال في العروس؛ هديت العروس إلى زوجها (mufradat)؛ الهدى العروس وقد هديت إلى بعلها هداء (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü öncelikle bir topluluktan sığınma veya güvence isteyen ve kutsal sunuya benzer dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkeği anlatır; bazı açıklamalar aynı biçimi tutsak için de verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak sığınmacı ile tutsak tek bir durum gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak kişi adı, dokunulmaz sığınmacı çekirdeği ve tutsak varyantıyla tanımlanır; kutsal sunu veya gelin anlamı buraya alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluktan sığınma veya güvence isteyen ve bu yüzden dokunulmaz sayılan erkektir. Bazı kaynak açıklamalarında aynı ad tutsak erkek için de kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğa sığınan veya onlardan güvence alan, dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkektir.
Bazı kaynak açıklamalarında aynı ad tutsak erkek için kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, güvence isteyen ve kutsal sunuya benzer dokunulmazlığı bulunan erkeği öne çıkarır; tutsak anlamı ise aynı ad için aktarılan ayrı bir açıklama olarak korunur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ana kişi türünü ve onunla birleştirilmemesi gereken tutsak varyantını birlikte görünür kılar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الهدي للرجل ذي الحرمة المستجير أو الآخذ عهدا قبل أن يجار وللأسير في بعض الأقوال
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرجل الذي له حرمة كحرمة هدي البيت؛ يقال للأسير أيضا هدي (sihah)؛ الهدي الرجل ذو الحرمة وهو أن يأتي القوم يستجيرهم أو يأخذ منهم عهدا؛ يقال للأسير أيضا الهدي (tahdhib)؛ وقيل الهدي الأسير (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü sağa sola sallanarak yürümeyi ve güçsüz kişinin iki kişiye dayanarak yürümesini açıkça ayırır; kadınların ve ağır develerin yürüyüşü örnek olarak verilir. Dal çerçevesi hareket, dayanak ve neden ayrımlarını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sallanarak yürüme biçimi ile iki kişi arasında onlara dayanarak yürüme kalıbı ayrı yüzler olarak tanımlanır; dayanak koşulu bütün kullanımlara yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yürürken sağa sola sallanmak veya yalpalamaktır. Güçsüz bir kişinin iki kişi arasında ilerleyip ikisine dayanması bunun özel yapısıdır; kadınların ve ağır develerin yürüyüşü örneklenir.

facets.statement: Yürüyüş sırasında sağa sola sallanma ve yalpalama hareketidir.
Güçsüz kişinin iki kişi arasında yürüyerek her ikisine dayanması özel yapıdır.
Kadınların ve ağır develerin sallantılı yürüyüşü bu hareketin örnekleri olarak verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sallantılı yürüyüş ile güçsüzlük yüzünden iki kişiye dayanarak ilerleme yapısında birleşir; kadın ve ağır deve yürüyüşleri çekirdeği açıklayan örneklerdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yürüyüş sırasında sallanma ve iki kişinin arasında ilerleme bu dala özgüdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu dali inisi zor ve sarp olan tepe ya da gecit olarak verir; develerin oradan yuvarlanabilmesi orneklenen tehlikedir. Anlam kisi zayifligi, yikim veya ses degil, arazinin zorlu inis niteligidir.

concept_map.definition: Bu dal, inisi zor, sarp ve gecisi zahmetli tepe, yokus veya gecit anlamindadir. Tehlike, uzerinden inen canlinin yuvarlanabilecek kadar zor bir arazi olmasindan gelir.

facets.statement: Inisi zor ve sarp olan arazi cikintisi veya gecit.
Tepe veya yokus gibi yuksek arazi bicimi olabilir.
Develerin boyle yerden yuvarlanmasi zorluk ve tehlike ornegidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali sarp, inisi zor ve zahmetli arazi olarak verir. Bir anlatim bu zorlugu, develerin oradan yuvarlanabilmesiyle ornekler.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karsi dal duz, kolay, alcak veya engebesiz araziyi anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de arazinin gecilebilirlik ve engebe niteligini degerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal zorlu ve sarp gecise, komsu dal ise kolay veya duz zemine yonelir; arazi niteligi bakimindan karsitlik kurarlar.
